browserScale.method: Actual loopback HTTPS, native cache, no interception. Repository static resources are no-store; tracked counts isolate synthetic product imagery. Heap values are Chrome estimates, not decoded-image or total process memory. Fallback fonts only; no production/CDN/billing claims.

isolation.probeSourceLabel: Unmodified BLACKBOX 33 feasibility probe retains its original baseline sourceCommit label; actual executed checkout is source.testedCommit and Stage A opens no application fixture.

priorRuns.finding: Eager-oriented scroll/URL assertions plus a dependent basket failure; no unexpected destinations/page errors. Adapted harness and reserved stable demand layout.
Fixture defaults referred to components outside synthetic permitted IDs. Added complete B33-style identifier/specification fixture graph and actual repository/kit-model prevalidation.
Final additional adversarial fixture exposed portable-archive symlink acceptance; a regular-object/type and pre-read size guard was then added.

evidenceScope: Selected results and screenshots durably retained in Git. Full raw browser events remain in the CI artifact; not production/CDN/billing telemetry.
